title: Trace Integrity for LLM Data Agents: A Vision for Auditable Structured Reasoning in Real-World Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.26036v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Answer accuracy is an insufficient reliability signal for LLM data agents. In structured-data tasks, a benchmark-correct answer can be produced by an invalid trace. This paper introduces Trace Integrity, a deployment reliability criterion for evaluating whether the computation recorded behind an answer is explicit, executable, schema-valid, operator-faithful, replayable, answer-consistent, and auditable. We identify the Structure Gap as the deployment failure mode that makes Trace Integrity necessary: natural-language reasoning and free-form rationales do not reliably specify the operator-level programs required by real-world systems. We operationalize Trace Integrity with execution contracts, structured artifacts that bind user intent to schema elements, operator plans, assumptions, executable queries, verification status, and final-answer linkage. We also introduce CAIT (Correct Answer / Invalid Trace) Rate, which measures how often

translated_title: 面向LLM数据代理的痕迹完整性：现实世界系统中可审计结构化推理的愿景
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.26036v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：答案准确性对于LLM数据代理而言并不是一个充分的可靠性信号。在结构化数据任务中，一个基准测试正确的答案可能由无效的痕迹产生。本文引入了“痕迹完整性”这一部署可靠性标准，用于评估答案背后记录的计算是否明确、可执行、符合模式、忠实于操作符、可重放、与答案一致且可审计。我们识别出“结构差距”作为部署失败模式，这使得痕迹完整性变得必要：自然语言推理和自由形式的理由并不能可靠地指定现实世界系统所需的操作符级程序。我们通过执行合同将痕迹完整性付诸实践，这些结构化工件将用户意图与模式元素、操作符计划、假设、可执行查询、验证状态和最终答案链接绑定在一起。我们还引入了CAIT（正确答案/无效痕迹）率，用于衡量这种情况发生的频率。
tldr: 本文提出“痕迹完整性”作为评估LLM数据代理可靠性的新标准，通过执行合同和CAIT率解决结构化数据任务中答案正确但计算无效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Trace Integrity as a new reliability criterion for LLM data agents, operationalized via execution contracts and the CAIT rate to address cases where correct answers arise from invalid computation in structured-data tasks.
